entry_conditions: Supported entry at the beginning of the expanded slice has the red block released on or near the outside pad, drawer_position already above the open threshold, and the gripper open with per-finger qpos near 0.04 m while the TCP is still over or leaving the red-pad region. Later entry is also supported when the TCP is already near the blue block but high above it; the causal cues are tcp_pose minus blue_pose, finger opening, current blue height, red_pose relative to red_goal, and drawer_position.
exit_conditions: Exit when observations show the blue block has been contacted and lifted: TCP and blue_pose are close in xy, the blue center is well above the tabletop, fingers are closed around roughly 0.018 m per finger, and TCP/blue motion is co-moving. In the cited demonstrations the end of this skill has blue z approximately 0.24-0.28 m and the gripper closed.
overlap_role: Indices 650-760 overlap the predecessor red_transport_place_pad as the robot retreats from the red pad and begins the global transit toward the blue block. Indices 810-870 overlap the successor blue_transport_to_drawer as the gripper closes, contact is established, and the blue block is lifted to a travel-ready height.
successor_readiness: blue_transport_to_drawer should receive control once the blue block is attached or imminently attached, fingers are closed, and the blue block is lifted clear of the table so that transport toward the drawer can begin. A geometric position above the blue block alone is not sufficient; the successor needs the closed-grasp/lift state visible in qpos, tcp_pose, and blue_pose.
failure_signatures: Likely failure cues include red_pose not on the outside pad at entry, drawer_position not open, gripper remaining closed during the approach phase, TCP-blue xy offset staying large during descent, fingers closing while TCP is not over blue, or blue_pose z failing to increase after closure. These are observation cues for policy selection and monitoring, not hard constraints enforced by this model.
continuation_guidance: Continue this policy through the full transition while TCP-blue distance is decreasing, the gripper remains open for approach or is closing at contact, and blue z is still near tabletop or rising. If invoked at index-like states around 650 it should perform the red-pad retreat and transit; if invoked around 760 it should continue from the high approach over the blue region; if invoked around 810 it should complete closure and lift. Transfer after the blue block is lifted and co-moving with the TCP rather than merely when the TCP reaches the blue xy position.
limitations: Observed support comes from the assigned demonstrations and expanded slices only. The policy does not implement a hand-coded rejection gate, IK recovery, object search, or repair for a blue block displaced far from the demonstrated region. Contact and attachment are inferred from observations and learned labels; there is no direct force or grasp sensor.
